✅ Multi-connection downloads (up to 32 per file)
✅ Resumable downloads across restarts and reboots
✅ HLS/DASH stream downloading and conversion to MP4/WebM/MKV
✅ Built-in torrent support (DHT, uTP, port mapping, etc.)
✅ Support for cloud share links (Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, etc.)
✅ Browser extension integration (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox)
✅ Download queues, scheduling, and automatic retries
✅ Traffic shaping, quotas, and metered connection management
✅ Private and secure (no accounts, ads, or telemetry)

Zipline is a Go-based download manager for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It enhances download speeds through multi-connection downloads, supports various file types including torrents and video streams, and offers features like download resuming, scheduling, and bandwidth management.

witr is a command-line and TUI tool that traces the origin of running processes, ports, containers, and files. It answers the question "Why is this running?" by mapping entities back to their originating PID and detailing their ancestry, context, and dependencies, providing output in human-readable reports or machine-readable JSON.
